notes: Sourced from Arista's official CCS-720XP Campus Switches datasheet (PDF). The 720XP-48Y6 provides 48x 10M-1GbE RJ45 PoE (802.3af/at, up to 30W/port) plus 6x 25G SFP28 uplinks (multi-rate 1G/10G/25G), 1 USB port, 1 console port, and 1x 100M/1G dedicated management RJ45 port; 1RU, 700Gbps switching bandwidth, 198Gbps (396Gbps FDX) throughput. Default power supply is PWR-1021-AC (1050W); also supports PWR-621-AC (650W), PWR-2021-AC (2000W), and DC options PWR-521-DC (500W)/PWR-721-DC (700W, screw-terminal DC input, not a standard connector in the list). AC PSU input connector is IEC-320-C16 (mapped to 'iec' as the closest allowed id — note C16 is a higher-temperature-rated variant of the C13/C14 family, same physical shape). Console port connector type (RJ45 vs DB9) could not be confirmed from available sources but is mapped to rs232 by function; USB-A generation/speed not stated in datasheet. Second PSU bay is field-optional, not populated by default. Model number suffixes (e.g., -F, -2F, -SSD variants) affect included optics/software but not physical port layout.

ports.name: Console
ports.note: Serial console port for CLI/EOS management; physical connector on Arista 720XP rear panel not independently confirmed as RJ45 vs DB9 in sourced material, treated as RS232-class serial

ports.name: USB
ports.note: 1x USB port for restore/configure and file transfer; speed grade inferred (not explicitly stated), typical for this platform class

ports.name: PSU 1 (AC In)
ports.note: Default 1x PWR-1021-AC 1050W supply (options: 650W/1050W/2000W AC, or 500W/700W DC); input connector is IEC-320-C16 (closest listed option is IEC C13/C14 family). Second PSU bay is optional/field-installable for N+1 redundancy.
